# `inv_001_paid_60_on_the_15th.txt` with that payment's date changed to
# 2026-01-16 and a second payment of 40.00 added on 2026-01-20. A changed date
# describes another movement, so the payment the book holds pairs with no block
# and the file is not only adding a payment.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-001"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-001"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-16
		amount: 60
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "First part"
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-20
		amount: 40
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Second part"
